messages.author: 37abdbe6ce54889a
messages.subject: Error running in Linux
parts:
Hi Dear INLA Experts, 

I am running INLA program in TACC server which I've tested in windows-based server, now I get the following error message:

FATAL: kernel too old
sh: line 1: 19408 Segmentation fault      '/home1/03484/xuehan/Rlibs/INLA/bin/linux/inla64' -b -s -v '/tmp/Rtmptxi6Pv/file4a4d1cdf4fca/Model.ini' > /tmp/Rtmptxi6Pv/file4a4d1cdf4fca/Logfile.txt
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.


Can anybody tell me what the message is trying to deliver ? I really appreciated any comments or suggestions or solutions !

Thanks in advance !

I'm running it in Linux because later I will run a more complex model which cannot run in the windows server. But this test step is already failed...


Regards,
Xiao

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error running in Linux
parts:
On Sat, 2016-01-30 at 09:46 -0800, Xiao Li wrote:
> 
> I am running INLA program in TACC server which I've tested in
> windows-based server, now I get the following error message:
>
> FATAL: kernel too old

Hi,

the inla-program that is  binary that follow that package, is compiled
under the 3.13-series of the linux kernel. I guess you try to run it on
a machine running the 2.6 version or even the 2.4 version. so either
you have to upgrade the machine or compile it yourself. 

you can check like this

hrue@inla:~$ uname -a
Linux inla.math.ntnu.no 3.13.0-68-generic #111-Ubuntu SMP Fri Nov 6
18:17:06 UTC 2015 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
h

H

--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
